# Dunmore Print Works - press-scheduler configuration

`press-scheduler` queues plate changes and wash cycles across the Dunmore press hall.

Two config layers apply: config/press-scheduler.json is the production instance config and config/press-defaults.json is the platform defaults. A key set in the instance config wins; any key the instance config does not set falls back to the defaults. A key in neither layer has no value at all.

turns.prompt: Dunmore Print Works is auditing the press-scheduler service and needs two effective settings: ink_level_poll_s and plate_wash_interval_h. What are they?
